---
title: ANSI output
engine: julia
---

One expression per cell, so the only plain-versus-recorded difference left is ANSI
(a several-expression cell is interleaved on the recorded route, a separate accepted change).

```{julia}
printstyled("colored stdout\n"; color = :red)
```

```{julia}
printstyled(stderr, "colored stderr\n"; color = :blue, bold = true)
```

```{julia}
using Test
@test 1 + 1 == 2
```
